primary_question: Under an independently defined epidemic transition and a strictly past-only operational analysis, is there sufficient evidence to replace Morlet w0=6?

design.truth: known day on which latent time-varying Rt crosses 1 from below
design.observation_target: latent Rt-crossing day plus the simulated median reporting delay
design.data_model: integer renewal-process incidence with negative-binomial transmission, binomial ascertainment, discrete reporting delay, weekday batching and matched no-crossing controls
design.coi_policy: use only the latest anchor at which every scale in the prespecified band is outside the candidate-specific power e-folding COI; score availability is the prefix end
design.primary_endpoint: first operational alert availability time; back-cast anchor is never counted as alert time

validation.selection_rule: replace baseline only if safety gates pass and the upper confidence limit for paired candidate-minus-baseline loss is below -minimum_mean_loss_improvement

claim_boundaries: The legacy formal run is diagnostic and cannot establish the optimal mother wavelet.
New simulation validation is internal validation, not external validation.
Unlabelled real outbreaks are descriptive transportability applications, not accuracy validation.
A retained baseline means insufficient evidence to replace it, not proof of global optimality.
